Goma Wakame Salad.note: Sesame oil and seeds; no soy sauce named. 'mild' with chilli threads = 1.

Gyudon.note: Dashi = fish; soy sauce = soy + gluten; onsen egg; mirin and sake = not halal.

Teriyaki Chicken Don.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten; sesame seeds. Mirin-style seasoning stated alcohol-free and 'no alcohol': halal.

Vegetable Tempura Don.note: Wheat and egg batter; tendon sauce: dashi = fish (sounds vegetarian, is not), soy sauce = soy + gluten, mirin = not halal. Okra, no chilli.

Tofu Teriyaki Don.note: Tofu, edamame, soy sauce = soy + gluten. Merchant tag vegan; mirin = not halal (rule h).

Mochi Trio.note: Glutinous rice and potato starch, no gluten; black sesame paste = sesame. Merchant tag vegan.

Matcha Ice Cream.note: Milk, cream, egg yolk; kinako = roasted soybean flour = soy (hidden).

Iced Calpis Soda.note: Calpis is a cultured milk drink = milk (hidden allergen in a soda).

Hakutsuru Junmai Sake.note: Alcohol = not halal. Rice wine has no allergen (rule h).

Asahi Super Dry.note: Alcohol = not halal; barley malt = gluten.
